verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a framework integration is a community user who switched to Weaviate to use LangChain's WeaviateHybridSearchRetriever. That shows a LangChain integration exists, but the user reports it can't run asynchronously. First-party docs only say generically that Weaviate can back RAG workflows; they never name LangChain or LlamaIndex integrations or say they are maintained. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of maintained LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations, any LlamaIndex or other agent-framework evidence, async support in the LangChain retriever, and evidence of first-class maintenance status.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations

citations.quote: Just migrated from Supabase + pgvector to Weaviate hoping to take advantage of langchain.retrievers.weaviate_hybrid_search.WeaviateHybridSearchRetriever.
